title: Configured token validity after an account disable
method: Synthetic timeline: token issuance at minute zero, account disabled at minute four, expiration at minute fifteen. Remaining validity is fifteen minus four. Actual revocation behavior also depends on cache and session checks.
alt: Configured token validity after an account disable: Token lifetime 15 minutes, Disable occurs at 4 minutes, Remaining token window 11 minutes. Illustrative inputs.
